tasks.title: Initialize Go Project Structure
tasks.description: Set up the Go module and create the basic project directory structure including cmd/, internal/, agents/, skills/, and profiles/ directories.
tasks.details: Create go.mod with module name 'github.com/griffin/cp-config', set up directory structure as defined in PRD, add .gitignore for Go projects.

tasks.title: Implement Configuration Types and Models
tasks.description: Define Go structs for agents, skills, profiles, and application configuration.
tasks.details: Create internal/config package with types for AgentConfig, SkillConfig, ProfileConfig, and AppConfig. Include YAML/JSON struct tags.

tasks.title: Implement Configuration File Parser
tasks.description: Create functions to parse agent and skill markdown files with frontmatter, and profile YAML files.
tasks.details: Use goldmark or similar for markdown parsing, gopkg.in/yaml.v3 for YAML. Handle frontmatter extraction from .md files.

tasks.title: Implement GitHub Directory Operations
tasks.description: Create internal/github package to handle operations on ~/.github/copilot directory.
tasks.details: Functions for reading, writing, listing, and managing files in ~/.github/copilot/agents and ~/.github/copilot/skills directories.

tasks.title: Implement Profile Management
tasks.description: Create internal/profile package for managing configuration profiles.
tasks.details: Support creating, switching, listing, and deleting profiles. Store active profile state. Handle include/exclude lists for agents and skills.

tasks.title: Set Up CLI Framework with Cobra
tasks.description: Initialize the CLI application using cobra for command handling.
tasks.details: Set up cmd/cp-config/main.go with root command, version flag, and help text. Configure cobra for subcommand structure.

tasks.title: Implement 'list' Command
tasks.description: Add command to list available agents and skills from the repository.
tasks.details: cp-config list [agents|skills] - Display available configurations with their metadata. Support filtering by type.

tasks.title: Implement 'install' Command
tasks.description: Add command to deploy configurations to ~/.github directory.
tasks.details: cp-config install [--profile <name>] - Copy agent and skill files to target directory. Respect profile include/exclude settings.

tasks.title: Implement 'add' and 'remove' Commands
tasks.description: Add commands to create new configurations and remove existing ones.
tasks.details: cp-config add <type> <name> - Create new agent/skill from template. cp-config remove <type> <name> - Delete configuration file.

tasks.title: Implement 'diff' Command
tasks.description: Add command to show differences between repo and installed configurations.
tasks.details: cp-config diff [--profile <name>] - Compare files in repo vs ~/.github. Show added, modified, and removed files.

tasks.title: Implement 'sync' Command
tasks.description: Add command for bidirectional sync between repo and installed configs.
tasks.details: cp-config sync [--profile <name>] - Sync changes in both directions. Prompt for conflict resolution.

tasks.title: Implement 'backup' and 'restore' Commands
tasks.description: Add commands to backup and restore ~/.github configurations.
tasks.details: cp-config backup [--output <path>] - Create timestamped backup archive. cp-config restore <path> - Restore from backup.

tasks.title: Implement Profile Subcommands
tasks.description: Add profile management subcommands (list, create, switch, delete).
tasks.details: cp-config profile list|create|switch|delete - Full profile lifecycle management.

tasks.title: Implement 'init' and 'validate' Commands
tasks.description: Add commands to initialize new repos and validate configuration files.
tasks.details: cp-config init - Create new cp-config repo structure. cp-config validate - Check all config files for errors.

tasks.title: Add Cross-Platform Build and Release
tasks.description: Set up Makefile and GitHub Actions for cross-platform builds.
tasks.details: Create Makefile with build targets for darwin/linux/windows. Add GitHub Actions workflow for releases.

tasks.title: Add Usage and Contribution Documentation
tasks.description: Create README.md with usage documentation and CONTRIBUTING.md with contribution guidelines.
tasks.details: README.md: Installation instructions, command reference, examples, configuration format. CONTRIBUTING.md: Development setup, code style, testing, PR process.
